difficulty_reason: Smoothing a curve lci at isolated points: construction of an affine open U_2 containing the singular points and generic points (quasi-projective + ample-finite-set lemmas), an affine smooth U_1 covering the rest, then smoothness of Def_X -> Def_{U_2} via the glueing-smooth lemma and unobstructedness through affineness + lci-unobstructed; the open-cover engineering is original here, the two closing citations are of lemmas this chapter itself proves in full. Retained author proof at lines 3083-3100.
